response.note: Compares UPI success rate by issuer and acquirer between 22-31 Aug and 1-10 Sep to locate where the drop is concentrated; the exact status and method_family literal values ('SUCCESS', 'UPI') are assumed, and the query cannot confirm a root cause by itself.
response.sql: SELECT period, issuer_name, acquirer_name, attempts, successes, ROUND(100.0 * successes / attempts, 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-11' THEN 'sep_1_10' ELSE 'aug_22_31' END AS period, issuer_name, acquirer_name, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE method_family = 'UPI' AND ((created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-22' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01') OR (created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-11')) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200) ORDER BY issuer_name, acquirer_name, period LIMIT 50
